To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structure of the apolar hydrophobic phase in emulsions affects the conformation of proteins at the interface.
the conformation of BSA at the interface depends upon the nature of the hydrophobic phase and that the nature of the phase has a major impact upon the structure of the interface.
the nature of the oil influences the structure of BSA at the interface of oil-in-water emulsion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the structure of protein emulsifiers at the interface of model emulsions.
the influence of the apolar phases of the emulsions on the conformation of BSA.
the influence of the nature of the hydrophobic phase on the conformation of BSA at the oil/water interface of emulsified systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the structure of the apolar phases influences the structure of BSA at the interface and the structure of B SA at the interface influences the structure of oil droplets.
the nature of the hydrocarbon phase has an impact on the protein conformation, the extent of adsorption of the protein at interfaces and its interactions with the oil droplets.
the nature of the hydrocarbon phase influences the conformation of BSA at the interface and the amount of protein adsorbed at that interface.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nature of the oil influences the conformation of BSA at the interface of the emulsion.
the nature of the hydrocarbon phase influences the conformation of BSA adsorbed at its interface.
the nature of the oil influences the conformation of proteins at the interface and thus their emulsifying properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure of proteins at interfaces of oil-in-water emulsion depends on the nature and the structure of the oil phase.
the conformation of BSA at the interface depends not only on the chemical structure of the apolar phases but also on its physical properties and its organization at the interface.
the nature of the hydrophobic phase has a significant effect on the conformation of proteins in emulsions.
